title: Add company-os read-only JSON list of canonical capture source keys
description:
Roadmap lane: measurement. Capture/source reporting needs stable labels so ops and reports do not drift from what the site emits. Implement a tiny unauthenticated or automation-key-gated GET route in `company-os` that returns the canonical set of capture source identifiers used by the storefront and ops views—distinct from a health probe of capture surfaces.

— proposed by briefing agent on 2026-04-17T23:46:05.791Z
acceptanceCriteria: With `npm run dev` running locally on the default port, HTTP GET `http://localhost:3010/api/ops/capture-source-keys` returns HTTP 200 and JSON containing `sources` as a non-empty array of strings with no duplicates; response must not include database connection strings or secrets.
testPlan: Start dev server, `curl` the endpoint, and optionally `jq` to assert `sources|length>0` and unique values.
